paper_metadata.title: A high-strength vacuum-brazed TiAl/Ni joint at room temperature and high temperature with an amorphous foil Zr-Al-Ni-Co filler metal

evidence.quote: An amorphous Zr 58.6Al15.4Ni20Co6 foil was fabricated and applied as the ﬁller metal to vacuum braze TiAl- and Ni-based alloys.

mechanisms.name: dissolution of base alloys in molten filler

evidence.quote: When the temperature reaches the melting point of the ﬁller metal, the ﬁller metal melts, and the base alloys dissolve into the melted ﬁller metal and react with it.
The high strength of the joint at room temperature and high temperature can be attributed to the following two strengthening mechanisms: ﬁne crystal reinforcing and dispersal reinforcing.
Some intermetallics such as Ti 3Al and Zr 2Ni would precipitate from the solid solution phases and dispersively distribute in the joint, which induces a dispersal reinforcing eﬀect at the joint.
